FlashVSR build-time subset
==========================

This directory contains only the FlashVSR sources required to compile
`mioh upscaler` and to perform its optional first-launch model conversion.
No model weights or generated Core AI assets are included.

Source workspace: local `FlashVSR_plus` integration snapshot
Base revision: `f489dd4eb8e5da6687351f8332e6a7cd88c01f63`

The Core AI deployment files include the local macOS integration used by
`mioh upscaler`. See `LICENSE` in this directory for the upstream license.
